title: Rook and knight: the Arabian mate

steps.prompt: In the Arabian mate a rook checks next to the king in the corner and a knight protects the rook and covers the last escape square.
steps.explanation: In the Arabian mate a rook checks next to the king in the corner and a knight protects the rook and covers the last escape square.
Rh7#: the knight on f6 protects the rook and covers g8.
steps.hint: Slide the rook along the 7th rank.

steps.prompt: Which escape square does the knight cover?
steps.explanation: The knight on f6 controls g8 and h7.
steps.hint: Squares next to the black king.

steps.prompt: Why can't the king take the rook on h7?
steps.explanation: A king can never capture a protected piece.
